intro: Lift Up hides what you don’t want to see and holds what you always reach for. It’s comfort and function, folded neatly into one beautiful shape.

features.title: Hidden help, always close by
features.text: Lift-up storage beneath the chaise and seat lets you tuck away everything from blankets to snacks—no clutter, just calm.

features.title: We keep your posture soft and steady
features.text: With a mid-height backrest and fibre-filled cushions, Lift Up is made for long movie nights and lazy weekends.

features.title: Arms rest with ease and function
features.text: Broad armrests double as support zones and cup holders, so your drink, remote, or book is always within reach.

features.title: Thoughtful tufting that stays in place
features.text: We added velcro-attached back cushions with subtle tufting—not just for aesthetics, but for gentle support that won’t shift or sag through everyday lounging.

features.title: We lift the sofa, so you lift less
features.text: The elevated base makes it easier to clean underneath while giving the sofa a lighter look—so your space stays fresher and your routine, simpler.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
